title: The border and fentanyl
current_phase: Fentanyl seizures at the Southwest border have fallen since 2023, while provisional US overdose deaths have also fallen.

history.text: Most fentanyl seized at the border is found at ports of entry, hidden in vehicles.

what.text: CBP's monthly data show Southwest border fentanyl seizures well below their 2023 level.
CDC provisional data also show 12-month overdose deaths falling; seizure weights reflect enforcement as well as traffic.

trend.label: Fentanyl seized per month, Southwest border (lb)
